title: espOS use case
description: A job a boat owner wants done, in their words. The flasher's start screen lists these; each leads to the firmware that does it and the boards that run it: those with every feature it needs first, then tested ones, then the most used.

title.description: What the owner wants, e.g. "Bring Bluetooth sensors into Signal K".

order.description: Position on the start screen, lowest first.

needs.description: Features a board must have for this job. Boards that have them rank first; firmware is only ever offered for boards its project lists.

projects.description: Ids of the projects that do this job. May be empty while the firmware is being written: the card then says it is coming.

reasons.description: Why a board suits this job, keyed by board id, shown beside it: "Wired Ethernet, so no WiFi drop-outs".
